entities.summary: Karl, Frieherr von Perfall was a German composer and conductor. A native of Munich, he studied in Leipzig, but spent the bulk of his career in the city of his birth, in which he died. Among his operas is Junker Heinz, to a libretto by Franz Grandour; his Raimondin, later revised as Melusine, was also successful. During his career he directed a variety of musical organizations in Munich.
